class.name: Ed25519Keypair
class.brief_description: A container for an RFC 8032 Ed25519 keypair, keyed by its 32-byte seed.
class.description: Holds an Ed25519 (RFC 8032, SHA-512) keypair. The canonical private-key representation is the 32-byte [i]seed[/i] (RFC 8032 terminology). The public key is derived from it. [b]Note on terminology:[/b] in this addon "private key" / "seed" both refer to the 32-byte seed; libsodium and others call the 64-byte [code]seed || public_key[/code] value the "secret key". The seed is wiped from memory when the object is destroyed.

method.name: generate
method.description: Generates a new Ed25519 keypair using the platform CSPRNG. The private key (seed) is a fresh 32 random bytes; the public key is derived from it. Returns null and pushes an error if the CSPRNG fails.

method.name: from_seed
method.description: Reconstructs an Ed25519 keypair deterministically from a 32-byte [param seed] (same seed always yields the same public key and signatures). Also accepts a 64-byte input, treated as a libsodium secret key, of which the first 32 bytes are taken as the seed. Returns null and pushes an error for any other length.

method.name: from_private_key
method.description: [b]Deprecated,[/b] alias for [method from_seed]. Kept for backward compatibility; new code should use [method from_seed].

method.name: get_seed
method.description: Returns a copy of the 32-byte seed.

method.name: get_private_key
method.description: [b]Deprecated,[/b] alias for [method get_seed]. Returns the 32-byte seed.

method.name: set_private_key
method.description: [b]Deprecated,[/b] stores the seed only (does not re-derive the public key). Prefer [method from_seed].
